baseline_models.focus_anchor: The human at word 3 is the emphatically marked subject of the bound-crossing verb at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visible human agency encounters an operative limit and moves beyond it; the sentence compresses subject, boundary, and breach into a recurring human tendency.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies a public, socially consequential subject rather than an abstract impulse.
Overstepping a bound in rebellion supplies the sentence's core motion and makes the human an active boundary-crosser.

changed_reading.before: The human rebels or behaves excessively.
changed_reading.after: The publicly present human becomes a boundary-crossing agent: transgression is movement past an operative limit, not merely a bad inner state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same subject-predicate link between words 3 and 4 permits the material overflow branch of the verb to organize the clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human presence behaves like a rising force that exceeds its container and then overwhelms what surrounds it. Moral excess is rendered as a change in pressure and capacity.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence gives the overflow a concrete social carrier and field of effects.
Rising, engulfing force supplies a hydraulic mechanism in which human capacity becomes pressure beyond measure.

changed_reading.before: The human commits too much wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Human force rises past its containing measure and begins to engulf its surroundings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at word 3 can activate familiar comfort while the verb at word 4 still anchors the result as actual overstepping.
baseline_models.mechanism: Familiarity removes estrangement and can also remove caution. The human oversteps from inside a sphere made safe and ordinary, so transgression incubates in comfort rather than only in hostility.

activation_trace.role: Comfort that removes estrangement supplies the low-friction interior in which vigilance toward limits can lapse.
Rebellious boundary-crossing supplies the consequential movement that familiarity alone cannot explain.

changed_reading.before: Estrangement from what is right produces rebellion.
changed_reading.after: Overstepping may arise precisely when familiarity and comfort make the human feel that no boundary remains dangerous.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering, measuring, distinguishing, and trimming form a calibration sequence around creation and teaching. The focus verb then reads as a deliberate departure from a measure already assembled, marked, and made legible.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence identifies the recipient of formation and instruction who later acts in public.
Crossing a limit supplies the breach whose prior calibration the context now exposes.
Gathering and assembling supply the first operation by which dispersed material becomes an ordered readable whole.
Measuring and proportioning supply an originating standard against which later excess can register.
A distinguishing mark that guides makes the limit perceptible rather than hidden.
Cutting and trimming hard material to level it supplies a concrete calibration technology for the teaching sequence.

structural_cues: The repeated reading imperatives and the teaching sequence precede the adversative-emphatic focus sentence.
The taught human of 96:5 is immediately followed by the human who crosses bounds in 96:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, measured formation, guiding marks, and leveling cuts; I infer that these establish a received calibration which the focus human knowingly exceeds. A live alternative is that the opening only lists gifts and does not specify their role in the breach.

changed_reading.before: The human crosses an unspecified moral boundary.
changed_reading.after: The human de-calibrates from a measure already built into creation and made readable through teaching.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attachment and nurturing completion produce a dependent human, but self-perceived sufficiency recodes that received formation as autonomous possession. Tughyan becomes enacted denial of the relations that made the agent possible.

activation_trace.role: The visible human is the formed dependent who later presents as an autonomous public agent.
Boundary-crossing is recast as the behavior through which dependence is practically denied.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supply an ongoing source of the human's capacity.
Clinging attachment supplies the human's originating condition of dependence and relation.
Claimed independence supplies the cognitive recoding that converts received capacity into imagined self-sufficiency.

structural_cues: Creation from attachment precedes the focus, while seeing oneself self-sufficient immediately follows it.
The same human noun occurs in the creation, teaching, and transgression sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, nurturing completion, and a later claim of independence; I infer that tughyan is the behavioral conversion of dependence into denied dependence. The live alternative is that material abundance directly causes excess without any remembered origin being at issue.

changed_reading.before: The human exceeds limits because human desire is naturally large.
changed_reading.after: The human exceeds limits by treating a nurtured, attached existence as if it were self-originating and sufficient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context offers several forms of elevation as naming, nurtured increase, and bestowed honor. The focus root's raised-rock image then distinguishes legitimate uplift from a hardened height that presents itself as self-grounded.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence locates the contrast in a person whose status can be displayed before others.
A smooth raised outcrop supplies the image of elevated, hardened self-positioning.
Elevation and rising supply a contextually prior upward motion associated with the invoked name.
The non-dominant mapped image of increase and elevation makes growth something received under lordship.
Bestowed honor and praiseworthy generosity distinguish gifted elevation from self-exalting height.

structural_cues: The focus follows invocation of the Lord and the Most Generous, then the sequence later returns to the Lord.
The focus verb can carry both excessive rising and a high-place image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elevation, nurtured increase, generosity, and a raised outcrop; I infer a contrast between bestowed growth and counterfeit self-elevation. The live alternative is that the split mapping under the Lord cue is only lexical proximity and should remain a secondary activation.

changed_reading.before: Any human elevation tends toward pride.
changed_reading.after: Tughyan is a counterfeit height: received growth hardens into a self-grounded position that forgets its giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human sees a self-image, treats that image as proof of sufficiency, and closes the field of vision around the self. The later assertion of divine seeing reopens that field, so tughyan becomes a perceptual feedback loop rather than abundance alone.

activation_trace.role: The small human image in the pupil supplies a literal self-image around which a closed gaze can form.
Overflow supplies the result when the reflected self expands beyond its proper scale.
View, spectacle, and mirror imagery turn self-seeing into an enclosed reflective apparatus.
Imagined independence is the conclusion the subject draws from the self-confirming image.
Disclosure to a knower makes the forgotten fact of a wider field cognitively available.
The worshipped divine referent supplies the observer outside the human's self-enclosed frame.
Actual seeing by eye or insight reopens the field and reverses the subject's assumption that only self-perception counts.

structural_cues: The pronoun in 96:7 makes the human's own seeing the immediate condition of claimed self-sufficiency.
The gaze is reversed in 96:14 when the transgressor is reminded that God sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-seeing, sufficiency, knowing, and an external divine gaze; I infer that closure of the visual field around the self causes the focus overflow. A live alternative is a simpler material reading in which wealth, not perceptual closure, produces the excess.

changed_reading.before: The human transgresses after noticing that he possesses enough.
changed_reading.after: The human transgresses when a reflected self becomes the whole field of evidence and is mistaken for proof of independence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The one-way surge of the focus is placed inside a larger return circuit. Return to the nurturing source, reinforced by returning-water imagery, makes tughyan an outbound excursion that cannot abolish the encompassing relation.

activation_trace.role: A rising, engulfing force supplies the apparent one-way escape from containment.
Nurturing completion identifies the destination of return as the same sustaining relation the surge seemed to leave.
Return to a prior state closes the outbound vector into a larger circuit.
Returning water materially folds the focus flood image back toward its source.

structural_cues: The return statement follows immediately after self-seeing and self-sufficiency explain the focus claim.
The destination is explicitly the Lord already named before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, return, returning water, and nurturing lordship; I infer a containing circuit in which apparent autonomy remains an excursion. The live alternative is that return names judgment without activating any hydraulic relation.

changed_reading.before: Tughyan is a successful movement out beyond restraint.
changed_reading.after: Tughyan is an outbound surge inside a larger return circuit; it exceeds a local bank but never exits the sustaining relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The transgressor stops another person's worship yet refuses to arrive at his own stopping point. Tughyan therefore becomes asymmetrical boundary administration: assigning an end to another while exempting oneself from an end.

activation_trace.role: Crossing the proper bound supplies the asymmetry between limits imposed outward and limits rejected inward.
The split-root image of an overbearing tyrant makes private excess operational as coercive rule over another.
Forbidding and restraining supply the outwardly imposed stop.
Humble worship identifies the other person's yielded orientation that coercive authority tries to interrupt.
The specified act of worship makes the imposed boundary bodily and observable.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the withheld self-limit demanded of the one who had limited another.

structural_cues: The same root appears first in stopping another and later in the demand that the stopper himself stop.
The prohibited act is another person's prayer, so the excess moves from an intransitive tendency into social control.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, worship, coercive tyranny, and an endpoint; I infer a role reversal that exposes monopoly over where limits apply. A live alternative is that the two uses of the stopping root are ordinary verbal repetition without a theory of asymmetric power.

changed_reading.before: The human simply refuses limits for himself.
changed_reading.after: The transgressive human claims the authority to set another's limit while refusing the corresponding endpoint for himself.

context_deltas.mechanism: A raised, hardened human position is reversed at the body's front: the forelock can be seized from above, while refusal of false compliance permits voluntary bowing and nearness. Vertical height and relational proximity move in opposite directions.

activation_trace.role: The raised outcrop supplies a material profile for the human's hardened self-elevation.
Seizing by the forelock supplies the involuntary reversal of the elevated posture.
The forelock localizes the reversal at the leading, self-presenting part of the body.
Obedience supplies the allegiance that must first be refused before bodily orientation can change.
Bowing the head supplies a voluntary downward motion that answers the earlier self-elevation.
Nearness makes voluntary lowering relationally ascending even while it is spatially downward.

structural_cues: The corrective particle recurs before the forelock threat and before the final sequence of refusal, prostration, and approach.
The sequence contrasts involuntary seizure of the head with voluntary lowering of it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a high-place image, forelock seizure, obedience, head-bowing, and nearness; I infer a vertical reversal in which self-height creates distance while chosen lowering creates proximity. A live alternative is that the body images are consequences of transgression rather than part of the focus verb's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Tughyan is an invisible degree of moral excess.
changed_reading.after: Tughyan is embodied as hardened self-height, reversed either by seizure at the forelock or by voluntary lowering that paradoxically brings nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: A human noise becomes a summons, the summons gathers an assembly, and speech acquires the force of a shove. The answering summons calls a repelling force, so tughyan scales socially and then meets a structurally matched counter-call.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the individual voice that can recruit a public collective.
The split-root image of a people's voice or noise supplies an acoustic form of excess that can scale beyond one person.
Calling and drawing by speech convert private noise into an outward summons.
The non-dominant mapped image of a forceful shove makes the summons an attempt to move others, not mere sound.
The assembled council supplies the social body through which one person's excess multiplies.
The answering call mirrors the transgressor's summons and reverses who controls mobilization.
Pushing, collision, and prevention supply the counterforce that answers socially amplified pressure.

structural_cues: The paired clauses set the transgressor's call and the answering call in direct antiphony.
The first call names an assembly, while the second names agents characterized by repelling force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voice, call, assembly, a split-root shove, counter-call, and repelling force; I infer that tughyan scales through speech-backed mobilization. The live alternative is a literal contest of summoned groups with no claim that voice constitutes the original excess.

changed_reading.before: A solitary human exceeds a limit.
changed_reading.after: Human tughyan can become a noisy social technology: a claim voiced into an assembly, scaled into coercive pressure, and answered by counter-mobilization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus excess is finally exposed as a rival orientation system rather than quantity alone. Refusing its claim breaks false authority; humble bodily orientation then produces nearness in the opposite direction.

activation_trace.role: The human-facing side supplies an orientation anchor: the issue is what the person turns toward and lets face him.
False transgressive authority supplies the rival center that demands compliance and diverts from good.
Obedience identifies the relational channel through which the false center would reproduce its excess.
Humble lowering supplies the contrary bodily orientation after false obedience is refused.
Drawing near supplies the relational result of redirected obedience and lowering.

structural_cues: The final three imperatives form a sequence: refuse compliance, lower oneself, then approach.
The sequence answers the earlier attempt to stop another person's prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false authority, obedience, humble lowering, and nearness; I infer an orientation circuit in which tughyan recruits compliance while its opposite redirects the body toward another center. The live alternative is that the final commands are remedies for tughyan without defining its internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Tughyan is simply too much action or pride.
changed_reading.after: Tughyan is misdirected allegiance organized around a false center; its reversal requires refusing that obedience and reorienting the body toward nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant fullness image under the seeing root as a material state rather than as sight. It remains anchored because 96:7 directly couples self-seeing with sufficiency and the focus verb has an explicit overflow branch. Render it as a hydraulic analogy for perceived sufficiency, not as a replacement gloss for the seeing form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus human at word 3 can be an aware perceiver, while the verb at word 4 supplies literal surging beyond capacity.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving something into awareness supplies the self-diagnosis of being full or sufficient.
Surging beyond bounds supplies the spill that follows imagined saturation.
The non-dominant image of fullness that thickens and straightens supplies the material state the self believes it has reached.
Sufficiency supplies the perceived completion that leaves no room for further dependence.

changed_reading.before: The human oversteps because he thinks he is independent.
changed_reading.after: Perceived sufficiency fills the self past capacity, so tughyan is the spillover of imagined saturation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it links the pupil's miniature human image with a garment that lies by appearance. It remains valid as a visual mechanism anchored in the focus noun and bound-crossing predicate, then sharpened by self-seeing, denial, and turning away. Downstream prose should call it an image-surface analogy, not claim that human literally means deceptive image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 3 supplies the human image in the pupil, and word 4 keeps the image's distortion consequential as actual boundary-crossing.

activation_trace.role: The miniature human image in the eye supplies a self-representation that can be mistaken for the whole person.
Boundary-crossing makes the misleading image an enacted distortion rather than harmless appearance.
Mirror and spectacle imagery supplies the reflective surface on which the self-representation is trusted.
A garment that lies by its appearance supplies the model of an outward surface misreporting the condition beneath it.
Turning away supplies the maneuver that protects the deceptive self-surface from corrective inspection.

changed_reading.before: Tughyan is inward pride later accompanied by lying.
changed_reading.after: Tughyan can operate as a self-image that misreports dependence, then turns away to keep that deceptive surface intact.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant reading because it uses the non-dominant mapped neck and upright-column images under the final obedience cue. It remains anchored through the focus root's raised-outcrop branch and the explicit final bowing of the head. Render it only as corporeal geometry that intensifies the vertical-reversal model, never as a lexical gloss of the obedience form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 4 supplies elevated hardness, while the human subject at word 3 keeps the geometry attached to a bodily agent.

activation_trace.role: The person-facing side supplies a bodily orientation from which neck, head, and posture can be tracked.
The smooth raised outcrop supplies the focus image of rigid self-elevation.
The non-dominant long-neck image turns elevation into an extended bodily posture.
The upright column image intensifies the posture as rigid vertical self-presentation.
Bowing the head supplies the explicit counter-motion that breaks the neck-column geometry.

changed_reading.before: The human exceeds limits in an abstract moral sense.
changed_reading.after: Tughyan appears as extended-neck, column-like self-elevation whose rigid vertical claim is undone by bowing.

strongest_changes: Creation and teaching recast the focus breach as de-calibration from a received, legible measure.
Attachment, nurture, and self-sufficiency recast excess as denial of the relations that produced human capacity.
Self-seeing and divine seeing recast tughyan as a closed perceptual loop in which the reflected self becomes the whole field of evidence.
The repeated stopping root exposes transgression as a monopoly over limits: the agent stops another but refuses his own endpoint.
Forelock seizure, prostration, and nearness embody excess as self-height and its reversal as chosen lowering.
Call, assembly, counter-call, and repelling force preserve an exploratory model of tughyan scaling through public voice.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained simultaneously moral, hydraulic, perceptual, social, and spatial. Split-root inventories were especially productive: they exposed counterfeit elevation, coercive tyranny, acoustic excess, and bodily verticality without forcing those activations to replace the dominant boundary-crossing reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from received teaching to deliberate de-calibration is abductive; the sequence may instead juxtapose gift and ingratitude without specifying mechanism.
The mirror, saturation, voice, and neck-column readings depend on branch-distant or non-dominant mappings and should remain visibly exploratory.
The return circuit may be materially hydraulic or may simply frame moral excess within eventual accountability.
The focus may describe a generic human propensity, a socially empowered subtype, or both levels at once.
